The certificate of analysis: results against reference ranges with exactly one flagged out-of-range value — accent, bold, set larger, and captioned "Exceeds", never colour alone. Change the sample block and the results rows in `data.json` first; keep at most one flagged row per the accent policy. Caveat: spec limits are written in the set's "max" idiom ("1.3 max"), not "≤" — the bundled Unicode fallback font does not cover the math-operator block, and the engine reports any such uncovered glyph as a render defect; register a font containing it if you need the symbol form.

**Engine features exercised:** solid accent tab via flex shrink-wrap, per-cell flagged styling in a data table, three-slot signature row, single-page fill.

Render it:

```bash
npx @formepdf/html templates/lab-report/index.html -o lab-report.pdf
```

<h2 class="sh">Interpretation and recommendation</h2>
<div class="prose measure82">
  <p>Seven of eight analytes are within the reference ranges specified for sterilizer feed water at this facility. The heterotrophic plate count of 138 CFU/mL exceeds the action limit of 100; the duplicate returned 129, so the result is reliable rather than a plating artefact. Endotoxin remains well within limit, consistent with biofilm in the distribution loop rather than a breach of the membrane.</p>
  <p>We recommend sanitisation of the loop downstream of the polish cartridge, replacement of the point-of-use filter at sterilizer 3, and resampling at two points after seventy-two hours. Sterilizer 3 need not be withdrawn from service on this result alone; the resample should be treated as urgent.</p>
</div>

```css style.css
/* lab-report — certificate of analysis with reference ranges.
 * Accent policy (lab): one solid accent tab (the Final status) and the
 * single flagged out-of-range result — bold and captioned, never colour
 * alone. */
@page {
  size: Letter;
  margin: 52.5pt 57pt 40.5pt;
  @bottom-left {
    content: "Certificate of analysis LAB-2026-11408 · Kestrel Medical Center";
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #8A857E;
  }
  @bottom-right {
    content: "Page " counter(page) " of " counter(pages);
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #8A857E;
  }
}
.sheet { position: relative; }
.atop { position: absolute; top: -52.5pt; left: -57pt; right: -57pt; height: 3pt; background-color: #7B2233; }
.meta-lab { grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; }
.flagval { font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 11.25pt; line-height: 1; }
.sig-tight { margin-top: 16.5pt; }
.sig-tight .sigline { margin-top: 10.5pt; }
.sig-narrow { flex: 0.6; }
```
